Transitions
-----------
These enable you to define the transition between two states of an element\

*tarnsition property: property you want to transition (font size , width)
*transition-duration: 2s/4ms..
*transition-timing func: ease-in/ease-out/linear/steps..
*transition delay: this creates a pause before the animation actually begins.

CSS Transform

used to apply 2D & 3D transformations to an element

* rotate 

*scale
 transform:scale(2);
 transform:scale(0.5);
 transform:scale(1,2);
 transform:scaleX(0.5)
 transform:scaleY(0.5);


TRANSLATE
---------

transfrom:translate(20px);
transform:translate(20px,50px);
transform:translateX(20px);
transform:translateY(20px);

*skew

transform:skew(30deg);
